about.pageDescription: Discover Tranzor: mission, values and capabilities for business leadership.
about.heroTitle: A Portuguese brand with more than 30 years of reliable delivery.
about.heroBody: Tranzor combines technology, operations and executive support to deliver robust solutions across industry, retail and services.
about.missionBody: Transform processes and products with rigorous innovation while keeping the customer at the center.
about.futureBody: Be recognized as a strategic partner for companies that want to grow with quality and trust.
about.valuesBody: Integrity, excellence and sustainability are the foundation of everything we deliver.
about.experienceBody: Consulting, implementation and technical support with a dedicated team.
about.partnersBody: Reliable solutions for retail, industry and professional services.
about.innovationBody: We develop processes and products that help businesses operate with greater speed and precision.
about.commitmentBody: Tranzor develops high-impact projects tailored to each client with transparency and agility at every stage.

contact.pageDescription: Contact Tranzor for quotes, commercial support and business solutions.
contact.heroTitle: Talk to our team to find the right solution.
contact.heroBody: If you need technical support, project proposals or commercial partnerships, we are ready to respond clearly and quickly.
contact.detailsBody: Professional support tailored to your business.
contact.supportBody: Our team prepares objective proposals with clear timelines, fair costs and dedicated support from the first contact.

privacy.pageDescription: Learn how Tranzor collects, uses and protects your personal data in accordance with GDPR.
privacy.heroBody: Tranzor is committed to processing your personal data with complete transparency, security and respect for current legislation — particularly the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

faq.pageDescription: Clear answers to the most common questions about Tranzor solutions and services.
faq.heroTitle: Frequently asked questions with direct answers.
faq.heroBody: Access the information that helps you make quick decisions about products, services and partnership conditions.
faq.q1Answer: Use the contact form, send an email to geral@tranzor.pt or call +351 234 000 000.
faq.q2Answer: We are based in Aveiro and serve customers across the country with complete business solutions.
faq.q3Answer: Distribution, industry 4.0, technical consulting, retail technology and post-sales support.
faq.q4Question: How do I get a quote?
faq.q4Answer: Request a quote through the contact form or the Tranzor commercial email.
faq.q5Answer: Lead times vary by product and service, but our goal is always to deliver with speed and reliability.
faq.supportBody: If you did not find the answer you need, the Tranzor team is ready to help with projects, technical requests and personalized consulting.

start.message:
Welcome to Tranzor support.
How can I help you today?

account_link.message: You can manage your orders, keys and personal data in your client area.

key_menu.message:
Keys and licenses
What is your situation?

options.no_email: I did not receive the key by email
options.activate: How do I activate my license?
options.lost: I lost or can't find the key

key_no_email.message:
Check:

· Spam/junk email
· Correct email in account
· Wait up to 15 min

You can also consult your keys directly in the client area.

key_not_work.message:
Make sure:

· Copy without extra spaces
· Correct product and version
· Internet connected during activation

The correct key is also in your account.

key_activate.message:
Steps:

1. Open the software
2. Click 'Activate' or 'Enter key'
3. Paste the key
4. Confirm

Microsoft/Adobe products → activation in the online account.

key_lost.message:
Find your key at:

Account → Orders → View details

(shortcut below)

key_contact.message:
Send an email to:

keys@Tranzor.pt

Subject: Key issue — order number
Response within 2 working hours.

order_menu.message:
Orders
What would you like to know?

options.order_not_arrived: My order has not arrived yet

order_track.message:
Tracking:

Account → Orders → order number → 'Track shipment'.

Also in the shipping email.

options.no_tracking_link: I did not receive a tracking link

order_late.message:
Deadlines:

· Digital: immediate
· Mainland Portugal: 2–4 business days
· Islands: 5–8 business days

Deadline passed? We can open an investigation.

options.open_investigation: I want to open an investigation

order_wrong.message:
We are sorry.

For an exchange:
· Keep product and packaging
· Photograph it
· Contact us with the order number

Correct reshipment free of charge.

order_damaged.message:
Damaged:

· Photograph product and packaging
· Do not discard anything
· Contact us — replacement or refund.

order_contact.message:
Orders team:

orders@Tranzor.pt

Subject: Order nº ___
Response within 4 working hours.

return_menu.message:
Returns and refunds
What is your situation?

options.return_product: I want to return a product
options.no_refund_yet: I have not received the refund yet

return_how.message:
Online return:

Account → Orders → 'Start return'.
You will receive a free label.

return_deadline.message:
Deadlines:

· Physical: 30 days after delivery
· Digital: no return after activation (except defective key)

Original packaging and good condition.

return_refund.message:
After receiving the returned item:

· Card/debit: 3–5 business days
· MB WAY: 1–2 business days
· Transfer: 2–3 business days

Have you received confirmation of receipt?

return_contact.message:
Returns team:

returns@Tranzor.pt

Provide your order number and reason.
Response within 24 working hours.

invoice_menu.message:
Invoices and tax documents
What do you need?

options.where_invoice: Where do I find my invoice?
options.company_invoice: I need an invoice for a company

invoice_where.message:
Invoices are available at:

Account → Invoices (download PDF).

Also in the confirmation email.

invoice_company.message:
Invoice with company VAT ID:

Add tax details before purchase: Account → Tax data.

Change deadline for already made orders: 30 days.

invoice_wrong.message:
Urgent correction:

Send the order number and correct details.

invoice_contact.message:
Billing team:

billing@Tranzor.pt

Provide the order number and correction.
Response within 1 working day.

shipping_menu.message:
Shipping
What information do you need?

shipping_times.message:
Deadlines (business days):

· Mainland Portugal: 2–4
· Azores/Madeira: 5–8
· Spain: 3–5
· Rest of Europe: 5–10
· Digital: immediate

shipping_cost.message:
Costs:

· Free over €35
· < €50: €3.99 (Mainland)
· Europe: from €7.99
· Digital: always free

shipping_intl.message:
Shipping throughout the EU.
Outside Europe or large volumes: contact us before purchase.

resolved.message:
I am happy to have helped.

Is there anything else I can do for you?
